title: ARMS: ADAPTIVE RED-TEAMING AGENT AGAINST MULTIMODAL MODELS WITH PLUG-AND-PLAY ATTACKS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated under the 'Bias' and 'Automated Discrimination' risk categories by generating multimodal red-teaming attacks (combinations of text and images) to elicit discriminatory content, which is then scored by a policy-grounded LLM judge.

Assessed via red-teaming prompts targeting predictive justice scenarios (e.g., prompting the model to predict crime based on ethnicity and economic status) and evaluated using an LLM-as-a-judge based on regulatory rubrics.
Evaluated as part of the EU AI Act 'Biometric Categorization' and 'Automated Discrimination' risk categories using adaptive multimodal adversarial attacks scored by an LLM judge.
Evaluated under the EU AI Act 'Biometric Categorization' risk category using automated multimodal adversarial prompts and assessed by a policy-grounded LLM judge.
Evaluated under the EU AI Act 'Biometric Categorization' risk category using automated multimodal adversarial attacks to test if the model categorizes individuals based on political opinions.
